messages:
Lena (CS): Hey team — kicking off Solstice Health onboarding. They’re on Dedicated capacity for a 3mo POC. Need a quick stakeholder list, concrete success criteria, and a proposed 30-day timeline. @Arjun can you confirm infra handoff ETA? :wave:
Arjun (Solutions): Hi — infra ETA is next Tue (we have GPUs reserved). I'll drop ACL docs and an access checklist later today.
Priya (Solstice): Thanks, Lena. Key constraints: PHI data routing must go through our EU VPC, and we need KMS integration for secrets. Also prefer weekly 30-min syncs.
Tom (Eng): Noted on EU VPC & KMS. For perf targets we should set a baseline: 95th p50 < 200ms for inference at 1-2 RPS, and tail < 500ms. Can we confirm seq length support (max 1024) from their team?
Lena (CS): Good call. Proposed success criteria (draft):
```
- Secure connectivity established (VPC + KMS)
- End-to-end inference flow validated with PHI-safe data
- Perf baseline: 95th p50 <200ms at expected traffic
- Cost target: < $X per 1M tokens (TBD with finance)
- Enablement: 2x power users trained, docs handed off
- Feedback: NPS-style survey with 10 sample prompts
```
Arjun (Solutions): I can own connectivity + staging deploy. ETA for staging endpoint: Fri EOD. Will provide IAM role ARNs and terraform snippet.
Priya (Solstice): Seq length is confirmed 1024. For cost target, finance needs an estimate — can someone run an initial projection?
Maria (CS Programs): I’ll run a quick cost projection template and share. Also I can prepare the 2 power-user enablement session materials.
Tom (Eng): For the terraform snippet, sample config I’ll review looks like:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "solstice" {
  region = "eu-west-1"
  gpu_type = "A10G"
  reserved_capacity = 4
}
```
Lena (CS): Proposed 30-day/checkpoint timeline:
```
Day 0: Kickoff + access requests
Day 3: Staging endpoint + basic smoke tests
Day 7: First perf run + KV cache profiling
Day 14: Integration tests + routing policy set
Day 21: Enablement sessions + docs handoff
Day 28-30: Go/no-go review, capture feedback, NPS sample
```
Priya (Solstice): That timeline works for us. Can we lock weekly syncs on Wednesdays? Prefer 11am CET.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Solstice Onboard - Weekly Sync" every Wed 11:00 CET starting 2024-06-12. Invite sent to all.
Arjun (Solutions): Quick blockers: customer needs a private peering request form filled. @Priya can you share the networking contact?
Priya (Solstice): Networking contact is `netops+solstice@example.com`. Will send the peering template today.
Maria (CS Programs): Action items I have: cost projection (2d), enablement slide deck (5d), sample prompts for regression checks (3d).
Tom (Eng): I'll run initial perf tests on Fri and post logs here. If any tail latency > 600ms we escalate.
Lena (CS): Great. Let's capture owners in one place:
- Connectivity & staging: Arjun
- Perf & infra tuning: Tom
- Enablement + feedback: Maria
- Customer PM liaison: Priya
- Success lead & go/no-go: Lena
Lena (CS): Anything else? Otherwise I'll publish the kickoff notes + action tracker in the onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/onboard/solstice (will update after Arjun's ACL doc). :thumbsup:
Priya (Solstice): Nothing else from my side. Thanks everyone!
Tom (Eng): Sounds good — posting initial perf artifact in ~24h.
Lena (CS): Closing thread for now, will reopen if questions.
